text: Overnight, we put one rotating parent paper on trial, then built the surviving idea's strongest version ourselves. This is Duho's personal side interest, not a NebulaMind research program. The paper's dark energy route fails its own numbers twice. The rebuilt, galaxy spin route reaches only 0.027 standard deviations with every observable galaxy. The idea's best version now exists on the record with its own number, and the number says the route stays closed.
